The '''Imperial Medical Corps''' was a division within the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] that was charged with the medical treatment and care of the Imperial forces&mdash;though like much of the Empire, the Corps discriminated against those who were not [[Human/Legends|Human]] or [[Sith (species)/Legends|pureblood Sith]]. The division was deployed on both active battlefields and conquered [[Planet/Legends|planets]], and the Corps fell under the jurisdiction of the [[Sphere of Biotic Science]] and the member of the Empire's ruling [[Dark Council]] who controlled that [[Spheres of Influence|Sphere of Influence]] within the Empire.

==Description==
The Imperial Medical Corps was a division of the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="Deceived" /> As they dealt with the medical and biological treatment and services of the Empire, the Medical Corps fell under the control of the Sphere of Biotic Science&mdash;one of the twelve [[Spheres of Influence]] that were each controlled by one of the members of the Empire's ruling [[Dark Council]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> However, after the Sith Empire was reorganized following the [[War against Zakuul|collapse]] of the [[Eternal Empire]], the Sphere of Biotic Science and the [[Sphere of Technology]] were both folded into a single [[Sphere of Scientific Advancement]].<ref name="Siege" /> The Corps's members oversaw medical care for the Empire's [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]], and its [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droids]] were stationed on [[Planet/Legends|planets]] throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] to provide medical care to all of the Empire's forces and allies.<ref name="TOR" />

==History==
The Imperial Medical Corps was founded well before the end of the [[Great Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and members of the Corps accompanied the Imperial Military's invasion [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] when the Sith Empire [[Sacking of Coruscant|attacked]] the Republic's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="Deceived" /> in [[3653 BBY]].<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> After the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Malgus]] and his strike team successfully attacked the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] and destroyed Coruscant's defense grid, Malgus ordered his subordinate [[Adraas]] to summon a medical team from the [[Hospital ship/Legends|medical ship]] [[Steadfast (Sith Empire)|''Steadfast'']]. The team brought along several [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droids]] and gurneys with them to treat the injured members of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] strike team, and Malgus overrode their restrictions regarding the treatment of [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] in order to force the [[Doctor/Legends|doctors]] to treat his [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] lover, [[Eleena Daru]].<ref name="Deceived" />

[[File:Imperial_medical_droid.png|thumb|left|200px|An Imperial medical droid]]
In the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] following the attack on Coruscant and the subsequent signing of the [[Treaty of Coruscant]], which ended the Great Galactic War, the Medical Corps continued to serve alongside the rest of the military on the planets that the Empire had conquered during the war. Among such worlds was the planet [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]], and during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] that followed the Great Galactic War, the Republic [[xenopathologist]] and combat surgeon [[Archiban Frodrick Kimble|Archiban Kimble]]&mdash;better known as Doc&mdash;infiltrated the Corps on Sullust and posed as a member for a short time.<ref name="Doc" />

Medical personnel were also stationed on the [[Quesh Orbital Station (Imperial)|Imperial space station]] above the toxic planet [[Quesh]], where they required new arrivals to submit [[Form 1423-D]] in order to qualify for inoculation and be allowed to travel to the surface.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=location|Quesh Orbital Station|Quesh}}</ref> Medical officers also supplied aid to the Empire's allies, with personnel such as Officer [[Willem]] providing support to the Imperial-aligned [[House of Thul]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] during the planet's [[Alderaan Civil War|civil war]].<ref name="First Do Harm">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|First Do Harm|Alderaan}}</ref>

==Equipment and training==
As members of the Imperial Military, Corps personnel were fully trained for combat despite the fact that they were rarely involved in actual fighting.<ref name="Deceived" /> Their uniforms were white<ref name="TOR" /> or gray robes with blue<ref name="Deceived" /> or red accents,<ref name="TOR" /> and they carried cases of medical supplies. Corpsmen were often accompanied by silver medical droids.<ref name="Deceived" /> These droids were also stationed across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] on both Imperial and contested worlds, and they offered medical aid and services to all Imperial and Sith personnel in addition to allies of the Empire.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> The Corps' policies were a reflection of the anti-alien sentiment present in the rest of the Empire, as Imperial medical facilities and services were restricted to [[Human/Legends|Humans]] or [[Sith (species)/Legends|pure-blooded Sith]] unless ordered otherwise.<ref name="Deceived" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial Medical Corps first appeared in the novel ''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]'',<ref name="Deceived" /> released on [[March 22]] [[2011]] as a tie-in to ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'',<ref name="Trailer">{{TORweb|url=info/news/news-article/20110304-1|text=Deceived Novel Trailer}}</ref> a [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] which was released on [[December 13]] of that year.<ref name="Patch">{{TORweb|url=info/news/blog/20111213-0|text=Welcome to ''Star Wars'': The Old Republic!}}</ref>
